answers.core: RayCast 2D is often used in enemy AI and while Area2D is useful, RayCast allows for greater precision when directed towards a player. Improving exception handling and allowing groups to be excepted from the editor (rather than in static code) will make the RayCast2D a more flexible tool overall and signals will allow more streamlined execution of detection.
answers.workaround: The workarounds I have found involve larger amounts of scripts and large amounts of if/else logic that can get cumbersome and more importantly, messy to work with.
